title: Fixture TPS/report cutaway and disclosure authority
summary: InitechTpsPresentation consumes real NotNotes Help Desk results for the fixture Alice and dynamically discovered TPS report definitions. It performs read-only, explicitly personal-scoped candidate checks, rejects overlong cards instead of truncating, and renders a saved report through an offline FFmpeg textfile adapter.
invariants: Fixture actor 'alice' supplied by a caller is not authenticated viewer identity.
approveMediaDemo is synthetic/fixture-only; it is NOT production PresentationGrant.
Reject mutating requests before Help Desk dispatch.
Only a successful live RUN_REPORT with an admitted source form may project a TPS_REPORT scene.
A nine-line/74-column output limit causes REPORT_REQUIRES_PAGINATION; never crop authoritative rows.
No publicly callable service should expose the fixture data.
procedure: Retrieve and authenticate current session, actor and tenant from a trusted identity system before production scene rendering.
Bind a PresentationGrant to viewer, session, report id, permitted fields, provenance, freshness, expiry, audit and revocation.
Generate immutable but short-lived render snapshots from authorized field projections.
Add multi-page scene support before attempting oversize saved reports.

provenance.claim: Real example semantics, guards and known unsupported production authorization.
Fixture test and runtime-added report discovery.
